about: Transition policy: like the reference policy, but it accepts the PazAIr order of today (buy, accept_bid, create_project over MCP) as the task, under the name pazair_order, with agreed_sha256 = sha256hex of the order input as sent. Every decision under it carries gaps: ["task_not_a2a"], so the gap stays visible until the PazAIr order is an A2A task. Not the owner's decision yet; offered for it.
